items.q: Of course, [Luciano] “Chano” Pozo [Gonzales] had just departed.

ctx.x: So, were some of the–you mentioned Sabu Martinez–were a lot of the Afro- Cuban pieces still being played by the orchestra at this time?
Yeah, that was the time, yeah. Of course, [Luciano] “Chano” Pozo [Gonzales] had just departed.
